svg.title: Green Curve
Green Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Flat base, blunt left end and tapering right tip preserved. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://high.org/collection/green-curve/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.

svg.title: Red on Red
Red on Red
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Two equal red panels offset diagonally. Thin darker seam is a viewing guide for overlap, not an additional paint colour. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red including an unpublished contributor photograph; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
